metadata.description: From a video on your child's YouTube Kids profile to a blocked channel network: investigate, list and block

plugins.name: youtube-kids-blocker
plugins.description: Finds out who is behind a video or channel (/youtube-kids-blocker:investigate-channel <link>), collects its sister channels into your own list, and blocks them on your child's YouTube Kids profile (/youtube-kids-blocker:block-channel <name>)
